field_principles.accuracy_delta: Guards against trading accuracy for speed; must be >= -2pp.
field_principles.compute_reduction_pct: Primary gate: must be >= 25 on real inference data (not synthetic labels).
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefix required. complete: if odar_real_validated is true.
field_principles.n_corpus: Must be 100 for statistical significance claims.
field_principles.odar_real_validated: Boolean gate. True only when compute_reduction_pct >= 25 from real probe EFE.
field_principles.routing_overhead_ms: Records EFE computation cost; must be <= 5ms to be negligible vs cascade cost.

routing_overhead_scope: median FreeEnergyRouter.evaluate wall-clock time on Tier 0 probe records
title: ODAR real Tier 0 probe routing overhead benchmark
